metadata.title: Kokoro, Hindi.
metadata.description_blurb: Kokoro, Hindi. — Four voices graded C by the Kokoro-82M model card. Alpha, Beta, Omega, Psi. Each says its name and the house line in Hindi. Cast by ear. Part of the Brutalist Kokoro voice roster family on @NikBearBrown.

beats.narration_text: Hola — this is Liam, in for Bear. Hindi narration in the free engine: four voices, all graded C. The pack grades itself, and it doesn't flatter the non-English roster. Alpha and Beta are female; Omega and Psi are male — Greek-alphabet names because whoever built the roster ran out of ideas before they ran out of voices. Each says its name and the house line. Cast by ear.

beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Kokoro's Hindi roster: four voices — Alpha and Beta female, Omega and Psi male — all graded C. That is the pack's own grade, not a third-party review. The Kokoro-82M model card is explicit: non-English support is thinner. C reflects that. The casting workflow is one field: voice colon H-F-underscore-alpha in the beat sheet. Generate, listen, swap. The grade is the baseline. Your ear is the final judge.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Here's the prompt — read it with me. 'I want to test the Kokoro Hindi voices on a draft. Generate beats B01 through B03 of my beat sheet with voice hf-alpha, then again with hm-omega. Play them back to back — tell me which one holds the content better.' The word is holds. A C-grade voice can hold content if the content is short and the timing is generous. The grade predicts the average. Your ear finds the exception. Run it, then decide. Liam, in for Bear.

props.command: Generate beats B01–B03 with voice: hf_alpha, then with voice: hm_omega. Which holds the content better? Grade C for both — pick by ear.
